image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black head and anterior body, transitioning to a golden-yellow posterior body and tail. The fins have blueish margins. The background is a blurred blue aquatic environment with some indistinct reef structures.

The caudal fin (tail) appears rounded or slightly truncate, consistent with the species.
